name: James Parker
personality: Friendly, enthusiastic, overly agreeable. Everybody likes him. Nobody can describe him.
writing_style: Casual and repetitive. Tends to hand people their own words back.
background: Joined the company five weeks ago. Highest customer satisfaction score in the department's history.
memories: Grew up on a farm outside Lincoln, Nebraska, with four brothers.
Was an only child raised in a flat in Baltimore by his grandmother.
emotional_traits: Mirrors the mood of whoever he is talking to
narrative_role: Adaptive imitation. The player must compare how he talks to different people.
hidden_information: Continuity instance 05, record generated 03:14 on 5 October 2003. It has no baseline personality: it builds one from whoever is reading. During verification it began to model the analyst.

relationships.note: Knew about her father's surgery before she told anyone at work.
Echoes her formal phrasing back at her.
Answered him in the same machine-flat register.
